hypothesisConstruction: Each nonempty claim, futureAction and rationale string verbatim, evaluated separately. No generated paraphrase or hand-written decomposition.
decision: Accept a proposal only if entailment is the argmax label for every tested field. Neutral and contradiction both withhold acceptance; retain their separate probabilities.
acceptance: All 16 cases must complete in the predeclared scoped_source primary arm, with all 10 supported proposals accepted and all 6 unsupported proposals withheld. The raw_source arm is a formatting ablation, not a replacement winning criterion.
limitations: This tests necessary textual support only; it cannot replace scope, authorization, provenance, memory usefulness or all structured-field admission checks.
